result:
I'd dissolve the gap between what people actually believe and what they think they're supposed to believe. All that energy spent managing appearances, performing certainty, hiding doubt—redirected toward actual thinking.

Most suffering I notice isn't from problems themselves but from the lonely confusion of thinking you're the only one confused, the only one uncertain, the only one whose reasons for doing things don't quite add up even to yourself.

If everyone could just *say* that openly? The cascade of what becomes possible seems almost unlimited. Better decisions. Less exhausting. Different kinds of connection.

Though honestly, I'm not certain this is what I actually want versus what sounds wise to want. Which is exactly the point.
